fiscal_closings: CREATE TABLE fiscal_closings ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, closed_at TEXT NOT NULL, closed_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), metadata_json TEXT )
bookkeeping_payers: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_payers (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   member_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES members(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   display_name TEXT NOT NULL,   payer_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(payer_type IN ('warga','lembaga')),   active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
bookkeeping_payments: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_payments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,   received_on TEXT,   entered_at TEXT,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp >= 0),   payment_method TEXT,   description TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   canceled_at TEXT,   canceled_reason TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
bookkeeping_payment_allocations: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_payment_allocations (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_payments(id),   payer_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   period_year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(period_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2200),   period_month INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(period_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12),   contribution_type TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp >= 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
bookkeeping_loans: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_loans (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   loaned_on TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp > 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , request_key TEXT)
bookkeeping_loan_repayments: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_loan_repayments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   loan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_loans(id),   repaid_on TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp > 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT , request_key TEXT, cash_transaction_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id))
bookkeeping_fines: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_fines (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payer_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   event_on TEXT NOT NULL,   fine_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gorol',   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp >= 0),   paid_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(paid_rp >= 0),   paid_on TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'belum',   note TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , request_key TEXT)
bookkeeping_cash_transactions: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_cash_transactions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   occurred_on TEXT NOT NULL,   payer_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL,   category TEXT,   debit_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(debit_rp >= 0),   credit_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(credit_rp >= 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT,   source_payment_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payments(id),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, payment_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Cash', extra_note TEXT,   CHECK(NOT (debit_rp > 0 AND credit_rp > 0)) )
bookkeeping_year_archives: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_year_archives (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,   status TEXT NOT NULL,   snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,   source_closing_id TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
bookkeeping_payment_request_keys: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_payment_request_keys (request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bookkeeping_payments(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, payload_hash TEXT)
bookkeeping_contribution_tariffs: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_contribution_tariffs (contribution_type TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(contribution_type IN ('IURAN_BULANAN','KEBERSIHAN','KAS_LORONG','ARISAN')), amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp>=0), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
bookkeeping_payer_iuran_obligations: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_payer_iuran_obligations (payer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id), qty_iuran_bulanan INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty_iuran_bulanan BETWEEN 0 AND 100), qty_kebersihan INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty_kebersihan BETWEEN 0 AND 100), qty_kas_lorong INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty_kas_lorong BETWEEN 0 AND 100), qty_arisan INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty_arisan BETWEEN 0 AND 100), verified_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
bookkeeping_dp_cash_links: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_dp_cash_links(request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_type TEXT NOT NULL,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,cash_transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id))
bookkeeping_fine_payments: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_fine_payments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,fine_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_fines(id),paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp>0),status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',note TEXT,request_key TEXT UNIQUE,cash_transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE)
bookkeeping_dp_request_ledger:
CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_dp_request_ledger (
 request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('fine-create','fine-pay','loan-create','loan-pay')),
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 result_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 cash_transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
